profile.name: Kumar S
profile.title: BIM SPECIALIST - MEP
profile.tagline: BIM Model Coordination • Clash Detection • Workflow Automation (Dynamo/LISP) • Scan-to-BIM
profile.summary: BIM Specialist with over 8 years of experience in BIM model coordination, clash detection, automation, and telecom drafting. Proficient in Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, AutoCAD, and Dynamo scripting to optimize project workflows. Adept at integrating multidisciplinary BIM models, ensuring standards compliance, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication. Strong expertise in new construction, scan-to-BIM, and telecom drafting.

highlights: BIM Model Coordination: Overseeing multidisciplinary BIM model integration for architects, MEP, and structural teams.
Clash Detection & Issue Resolution: Identifying and resolving model inconsistencies using Revizto & Navisworks.
Standards Compliance & Model Review: Ensuring accuracy, adherence to BIM standards, and maintaining data integrity.
Stakeholder Communication: Serving as the central BIM point of contact, coordinating with architects, engineers, and contractors.
Client Coordination & Design Support: Collaborating with clients to align BIM implementation with project goals.
Project Progress Tracking: Providing regular updates and assisting in design reviews with BIM data insights.

experience.metrics: Scan-to-BIM | HVAC, Plumbing, Fire Protection & Telecom
highlights: New Construction & Scan to BIM: Modeled HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection systems for various projects.
Telecom Drafting & Documentation: Created network layouts, antenna placements, and equipment installation drawings.
Quality Control & Compliance: Reviewed telecom infrastructure drawings for accuracy, ensuring compliance with industry standards.
Training & Team Development: Mentored junior engineers, improving team efficiency through process optimization.
